return_schema.instruction: Using the known declarative statement supplied in this return schema, identify each implicit materially distinct clause or proposition. For each clause, produce one complete subsequent statement by prepending exactly 'I affirm that ' to that clause. Preserve the meaning of the clause. Do not omit or merge materially distinct clauses.
affirmations: I affirm that reference_count equals documents_read.length plus documents_not_read.length.
